ACTIVE.meaning: Current assigned development branch. Agents may commit/push here for the assigned task.

INTEGRATION.meaning: Canonical integration/base branch. Do not commit directly unless the user explicitly instructs it.

FROZEN.meaning: Preserved open/in-flight work. Read/compare only unless the user explicitly reactivates this branch.

DEPRECATED.meaning: Superseded branch. Do not checkout as a work base, commit to it, open new work from it, or merge from it without explicit recovery instructions.

ARCHIVED.meaning: Historical snapshot/evidence branch. Read-only historical reference.

REVIEW_REQUIRED.meaning: Unclassified branch. Treat as non-writable until its lifecycle status is explicitly added to this registry.

agent_rules: Branch existence is not permission to use it.
Before editing, resolve the intended branch through this registry.
Only status ACTIVE is writable by default.
INTEGRATION, FROZEN, DEPRECATED, ARCHIVED, and REVIEW_REQUIRED are non-writable.
Never branch new work from DEPRECATED or ARCHIVED state.
FROZEN may be inspected or compared but not extended unless explicitly reactivated.
If conversational instructions conflict with an old branch name, prefer the newest explicit user instruction and update this registry.
When a PR is merged/abandoned/superseded, update this registry in the same cleanup batch.
Proof-submission branches under submission/proof/** are review artifacts and default to FROZEN after creation.

patterns.reason: Proof-submission branches are controlled review artifacts. After the submission commit/draft PR is created, general agents may inspect but must not extend them unless explicitly reactivated for review fixes.
Release/qualification snapshots are historical references unless explicitly reactivated.
Candidate branches are not current work bases after their evaluation window.
Executor stage branches are one-off proof/repair staging branches and must not be reused.

notes: Open PR does not imply writable: most open PR heads are FROZEN to prevent accidental continuation of stale parallel work.
Explicit branch entries override pattern matches.
This registry intentionally fails closed: unknown branches are REVIEW_REQUIRED.
